Let's sketch the graph of $y=\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x):$

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/capture/multivariable/14189988/assets/85a182aabfe64c27eaafde94e3bdbede9409b02cfd87395cb2fc5543b09c4e05.png)

The domain of $\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x)$ is $x\in [-1,1].$  

Now, substituting $x=1$ directly into the limit, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}{lim}_{x\to \,{1}^{-}}\frac{25\operatorname{arccos}⁡(x)}{{x}^{2}+\pi } & =\frac{25\operatorname{arccos}⁡(1)}{{1}^{2}+\pi } \\  & =\frac{25\cdot 0}{1+\pi } \\  & =0.\end{aligned}
$$
